name: Disrupt Decorum — goaded creatures carry "Goaded by <player>", as a trait only
notes: Conor's decision 2026-10-13: rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted are traits (never ability lines), in the words of the card with the players filled in; Goaded is a trait only and names the player who goaded. Parser block 'Rules about attacking, blocking and being targeted' in cards-parser.js, _resolveTraitText in engine-helpers.js. Cast by the opponent, it goads Player 1's creature: the trait names the opponent, and "Goaded" is no longer a line among the abilities.
